items.name: gitconfig_excludes_path
items.summary: Return the file path of the current environment's global gitignore file.

items.name: Gitignore
items.summary: Gitignore is a matcher for the globs in one or more gitignore files in the same directory.

methods.name: empty
methods.summary: Creates a new empty gitignore matcher that never matches anything.

methods.name: global
methods.summary: Creates a new gitignore matcher from the global ignore file, if one exists.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this gitignore has zero globs, and therefore never matches any file path.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of globs, which should be equivalent to `num_ignores + num_whitelists`.

methods.name: matched
methods.signature: fn matched<P: AsRef<Path>>(&self, path: P, is_dir: bool) -> Match<&Glob>
methods.summary: Returns whether the given path (file or directory) matched a pattern in this gitignore matcher.

methods.name: matched_path_or_any_parents
methods.signature: fn matched_path_or_any_parents<P: AsRef<Path>>(&self, path: P, is_dir: bool) -> Match<&Glob>
methods.summary: Returns whether the given path (file or directory, and expected to be under the root) or any of its parent directories (up to the root) matched a pattern in this gitignore matcher.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a new gitignore matcher from the gitignore file path given.

methods.name: num_ignores
methods.summary: Returns the total number of ignore globs.

methods.name: num_whitelists
methods.summary: Returns the total number of whitelisted globs.

methods.name: path
methods.summary: Returns the directory containing this gitignore matcher.

items.name: GitignoreBuilder
items.summary: Builds a matcher for a single set of globs from a .gitignore file.

methods.name: add
methods.signature: fn add<P: AsRef<Path>>(&mut self, path: P) -> Option<Error>
methods.summary: Add each glob from the file path given.

methods.name: add_line
methods.signature: fn add_line(&mut self, from: Option<PathBuf>, line: &str) -> Result<&mut GitignoreBuilder, Error>
methods.summary: Add a line from a gitignore file to this builder.

methods.name: allow_unclosed_class
methods.signature: fn allow_unclosed_class(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut GitignoreBuilder
methods.summary: Toggle whether unclosed character classes are allowed. When allowed, a `[` without a matching `]` is treated literally instead of resulting in a parse error.

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Builds a new matcher from the globs added so far.

methods.name: build_global
methods.summary: Build a global gitignore matcher using the configuration in this builder.

methods.name: case_insensitive
methods.signature: fn case_insensitive(&mut self, yes: bool) -> Result<&mut GitignoreBuilder, Error>
methods.summary: Toggle whether the globs should be matched case insensitively or not.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new builder for a gitignore file.

items.name: Glob
items.summary: Glob represents a single glob in a gitignore file.

methods.name: actual
methods.summary: The actual glob that was compiled to respect gitignore semantics.

methods.name: from
methods.summary: Returns the file path that defined this glob.

methods.name: is_only_dir
methods.summary: Whether this glob must match a directory or not.

methods.name: is_whitelist
methods.summary: Whether this was a whitelisted glob or not.

methods.name: original
methods.summary: The original glob as it was defined in a gitignore file.
